items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: No, I didn't know the men in the band. I met them, but to say, get a relationship with them, no I didn't.

ctx.x: And of course I've read it, that Sir Charles Thompson plays it. I've read that, I never knew. Who was that? Charles Thompson, the piano player. Well I didn't know the place. You didn't know the men in the band?

No, I didn't know the men in the band. I met them, but to say, get a relationship with them, no I didn't. Did you listen to Nat's band? Oh yeah, sure. In fact we played next to each other. Where was that? New Orleans. Yeah. Yeah.
